explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 83 to 56 lines (32.5%) and from 5,998 to 3,826 characters (36.2%). Six peripherals expand validation, evidence lifetime, request receipts/lineage, record ownership, model conversion and diagram identity. The center groups responsibilities rather than files; public operations and private state show modular boundaries, call sequences show control flow, and hashes/references show data dependencies. Calls describe supplied code, not observed runtime traces. Edges attach to relevant concept lines. Measured diagram bounds do not overlap.

Corrections: the seed's 'bytes exactly match HEAD' is too strong. fileAgentContextSources.ts:28-31,60-67 splits CRLF/LF before comparing sourceFileHash values, so reuse compares parsed content. The seed's version rules describe newly generated contexts; agentContext.ts:131-148 also accepts version 2/3 without ranges or sections when other validation succeeds. Branch cycle/missing-entry checks stop at fromEntryId rather than checking all ancestry (agentContext.ts:99-121). Diagram fingerprint generation is present, but automatic freshness comparison is not shown (diagramAgentContext.ts:28-30,63-85). The source adapter's '2 MiB' error/comment conflicts with its imported 16 MiB constant; diagrams follow the executable check.

Details beyond the seed include receipt checks before recapture/parent lookup, cache eviction and lifetime, code-unit chunking, per-occurrence expanded byte accounting, sourceId fallback, and full-record reads behind summaries. Evidence is limited to context.json's six pinned sources and point definition plus seed.json. Imported source-range/hash helpers, ImmutableRecords internals, store wiring and session launch callers were not supplied, so their implementations and end-to-end behavior are not asserted.

diagrams.ascii:
Reusable Agent Contexts
|-- AgentContext: validated conversation and pinned evidence
|   |-- Capture one trajectory branch, then reverse into conversation order
|   |   `-- Reject duplicate IDs, broken paths and incomplete tool exchanges
|   |-- Descriptor = version + source identity + selected range + messages
|   |   |-- User, assistant/tool calls and toolResult messages
|   |   `-- Text, source ranges and one level of named sections
|   |-- SHA-256 of canonical descriptor; attachments excluded
|   |   `-- Restore validates hash, tool sequencing and supplied attachments
|   `-- Private snapshot; callers receive clones; raw input limit is 16 MiB
|-- Source capture and transport
|   |-- Registered sourceId + path + line range + optional revision
|   |   `-- FileAgentContextSources resolves the source binding
|   |-- Revision available -> resolve commit -> read regular Git file
|   |-- Otherwise read document; Git worktrees compare parsed content with HEAD
|   |   `-- Matching content uses Git; otherwise retain immutable snapshot
|   |-- persist(): store attachments, check references, strip attachments
|   |   `-- Snapshot blobs live under agent-context-sources
|   `-- portable(): attach selected lines, rewrite references, rehash descriptor
|-- Durable library: AgentContextLibrary
|   |-- Depends on repository and optional source adapter
|   |-- create(): text, constituents/sections or validated snapshot
|   |   |-- Capture source constituents; text/constituents become one user message
|   |   `-- Persist via adapter when present -> saved-agent-context-<requestId>
|   |-- Request receipt: identical retry returns record; mismatch fails
|   |-- list(): search name/description, newest first, paginated summaries
|   |-- read(): compact snapshot plus separately resolved snapshot when requested
|   |-- update(group) and addComment(): metadata preserves snapshot hash
|   |   `-- New comment checks current hash and records hash/time
|   |-- fork(): verify parent hash, copy snapshot, create new saved ID
|   |   |-- Record parent ID/hash; inherit description/group unless overridden
|   |   `-- Comments stay on parent; identical retry returns existing fork
|   `-- lineage(): root-to-selected summaries and parent hash comparisons
|       `-- Missing ancestors or cycles fail explicitly
|-- File-backed durability: FileAgentContextRepository
|   |-- Owns <store>/agent-contexts/<saved ID>.json across canvases/chats
|   |-- Read validates record, matching ID and AgentContext snapshot
|   |-- Create: write/sync temp -> exclusive hard link -> directory sync
|   |   `-- Existing record accepted only when requestHash matches
|   `-- Metadata: acquire directory lock -> mutate -> write/sync -> rename
|       `-- Lock timeout is 5 seconds; finally removes temp and acquired lock
|-- Model input reuse
|   |-- resolveSources(): attached evidence first, otherwise injected reader
|   |   |-- Replace ranges with text; retain sections and tool calls
|   |   `-- Expanded sources capped at 16 MiB; return newly hashed context
|   |-- toPiMessages(): section labels and synthetic assistant provenance
|   |   `-- Unresolved ranges fail; provenance does not select runtime model
|   `-- Library reads do not launch a model or change the current conversation
`-- Diagram-bound reuse
    |-- compileDiagramAgentContext(): capture original evidence as attachments
    |   |-- One user message contains binding/evidence metadata and references
    |   `-- Retain diagramId, compiledFromRevisionId and sourceFingerprint
    |-- Fingerprint depends on binding/evidence; comparison is a caller concern
    |-- Captured evidence is background; later requests supply current diagram
    |-- Inline snapshot or stored backingRecordId + contentHash
    `-- Load validates snapshot hash, agent type and diagram identity

Conversation validity [agentContext.ts]
|-- fromTrajectory(): select a bounded branch
|   |-- Duplicate entry IDs rejected across the input
|   |-- Follow parents from throughEntryId; stop at fromEntryId
|   `-- Cycle/missing-entry checks cover the traversed path
|-- Tool exchange state: private pending map + seen-ID set
|   |-- Assistant calls add unique IDs and expected tool names
|   |-- Results consume matching IDs; orphan/duplicate/mismatch fails
|   `-- Pending results must clear before user/assistant or slice end
|-- Version selection differs from restoration acceptance
|   |-- New contexts: sections -> 3; otherwise ranges -> 2; else -> 1
|   `-- Restore: ranges require >=2; sections require 3
|       `-- Version 2/3 without ranges or sections can still pass
|-- Descriptor hash depends on source, range, version and messages
|   |-- Recursive object-key sorting; array order retained
|   `-- Attachment hashes/referenced use checked separately
`-- fromMessages(): builds a linear diagram-composer trajectory
    `-- Retains supplied session ID; assigns message-0, message-1, ...

Evidence lifetime [fileAgentContextSources.ts]
|-- Public capture/read/persist/portable; private blobs and pinned cache
|-- capture(): registry binding determines available storage
|   |-- Requested revision wins over bound Git revision
|   |-- With revision: resolve commit; ls-tree check; git show
|   |   `-- Accept only regular blobs with modes 100644 or 100755
|   `-- Without revision: readDocumentText() -> parsed source file
|       |-- Split on CRLF/LF; reject NUL; enforce 16 MiB constant
|       |-- Git HEAD reuse compares sourceFileHash of parsed files
|       `-- Otherwise blobs.put(file); return snapshot-hash reference
|-- Pinned cache is per adapter instance
|   |-- Key = root + commit + path; retain at most 16 promises
|   `-- Evict oldest insertion; remove failed promise for retry
|-- persist(): validate -> put attachments -> load distinct references
|   `-- Return descriptor without attachments; same contentHash
`-- portable(): load each distinct range and slice selected lines
    |-- Preserve startLine; attach selected file under its hash
    `-- Rewrite references, including section children; recompute hash

Retry and lineage [agentContextLibrary.ts + savedAgentContext.ts]
|-- Public library delegates storage; receipt hash is separate from contentHash
|-- create() with constituents/sections
|   |-- Hash name, description, raw constituents and optional group
|   `-- Check existing request ID BEFORE capturing source again
|-- create() with text or snapshot
|   |-- Construct/validate context first; receipt includes contentHash
|   `-- Check existing ID before source persistence
|-- Group absent: omit from receipt input to preserve legacy hashes
|   `-- Later group/comment metadata edits leave creation receipt intact
|-- fork(): receipt = hash of ['fork', parsed request]
|   |-- Existing matching receipt returns BEFORE parent lookup
|   |   `-- Retry survives later changes to fork or parent
|   `-- New fork requires current parent hash
|       `-- group omitted inherits; group:null clears; comments omitted
|-- lineage(): repository reads every ancestor; reverse summaries
|   `-- parentMatches compares pinned parent hash with parent's current hash
`-- Discovery defaults: query='', offset=0, limit=20 (maximum 100)
    `-- Case-insensitive search; equal dates sort by saved ID

Record ownership [fileAgentContextRepository.ts]
|-- Public read/create/updateGroup/addComment/summaries
|   `-- Private directory, ID-to-path helper and metadata mutation
|-- create(): own unique temporary file opened wx, mode 0600
|   |-- Write -> file sync -> close -> hard-link final path
|   |-- Existing destination is not replaced
|   |-- Directory sync -> read/validate saved record -> compare receipt
|   `-- finally: remove temporary file
|-- Metadata mutation serializes writers across processes
|   |-- mkdir(<record>.lock); retry EEXIST every 10 ms for up to 5 s
|   |-- Read latest record under lock -> mutate -> schema validation
|   |-- Write/sync/close temp -> rename final -> directory sync
|   `-- finally: remove temp, then lock even if temp removal fails
|-- addComment(): requestId becomes commentId
|   |-- Existing ID: compare text and expected hash; identical is a no-op
|   `-- New ID: require current hash, append timestamp and hash
`-- summaries(): enumerate saved JSON files and call read() on each
    `-- Returns metadata summaries but reads and validates full snapshots

Model conversion [agentContext.ts]
|-- resolveSources(): new cache owned by each invocation
|   |-- Canonical full reference is the cache key
|   |-- Attached snapshot wins; otherwise call supplied reader
|   `-- Missing both -> AGENT_CONTEXT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
|-- Expansion retains message order, sections and tool calls
|   |-- Repeated ranges share reads but each occurrence counts bytes
|   |-- Split text into blocks of at most 1,000,000 JS code units
|   `-- Choose version 3 with sections, else 1; rehash and validate
|-- toPiMessages() calls agentContextModelContent()
|   |-- Sections become opening/closing text labels
|   |-- Any remaining sourceRange throws
|   `-- Non-assistant content is filtered to text
`-- Assistant history gets synthetic provenance and zero usage/cost
    |-- api=openai-responses; provider=agent-context
    |-- model=source.agentType; runtime model choice is elsewhere
    `-- stopReason=toolUse when calls exist, otherwise stop

Diagram evidence identity [diagramAgentContext.ts]
|-- compileDiagramAgentContext(): no store required
|   |-- Copy originalLines with startLine -> attachment hash
|   |-- sourceId fallback: evidence entry -> binding -> diagramId
|   |-- Metadata replaces originalLines with source references
|   `-- Build one diagram-context user message at timestamp 0
|-- sourceFingerprint = SHA-256(JSON.stringify({binding, evidence}))
|   |-- Missing binding becomes null; no canonical key sorting here
|   `-- No freshness comparison or automatic refresh in this file
|-- storeDiagramAgentContext(): validate before publication
|   |-- Already stored -> return reference unchanged
|   `-- Inline -> store.put(snapshot) -> require 64-hex backingRecordId
|-- loadDiagramAgentContext(): inline snapshot or store.get(recordId)
|   |-- Missing backing data -> AGENT_CONTEXT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
|   `-- Validate descriptor hash, agentType and sourceSessionId
`-- validateDiagramAgentContext(): exactly one backing form
    |-- Check ID prefixes and hash shapes; inline contentHash is optional
    `-- Revision/fingerprint formats checked, not compared with live diagram
